Amr Moussa, Secretary-General of the Arab League from 2001 to 2011, is the one who sponsored the first Arab Creativity Oscar from the Arab Creativity Union in Egypt. The award went to Kuwaiti Qari Mishary Alafasy, and most sources date it to 25 October 2008, though one says 1998, which looks like a typo. I could not open primary sources, so this rests on search snippets from [EverybodyWiki](https://en.everybodywiki.com/Mishary_bin_Rashid_Alafasy) and [Barakah Insider](https://www.barakahinsider.com/shaikh-mishary-bin-rashid-alafasy/).
